title: Canonical theme palette
description: One canonical semantic palette per colorscheme. Roles are hue-independent; a role value is either a 6-digit hex or a reference to another role (@role-name). ANSI 0-15 are explicit hex. The native section carries the irreducible per-theme choices (Neovim/Zed colorscheme names). The module (theme/theme.py) is the enforcing validator; this schema documents the contract for review.

name.description: Palette identifier; also the bundle directory name.

roles.description: Semantic, hue-independent roles. Value is a hex or an @role reference.

overrides.description: Optional personal layer applied to the canonical base roles before reference resolution. Only existing semantic role keys may be overridden (base roles are validated independently first, so an override can never supply a missing canonical role); a value is a hex or an @role reference to another effective role, so references observe overridden values and cycles through overrides are caught on the effective graph. `reason` is optional provenance. Exposed to every adapter and quality check through the effective role set.

roles.description: Role keys that exist in the base palette, each overridden to a hex or @role value.

reason.description: Optional note describing why the override exists.

ansi.description: Terminal ANSI slots 0-15, in order. Explicit hex only.

ghostty.description: Ghostty UI colors beyond the ANSI palette. Values are hex or @role references.

native.description: Irreducible per-theme native selections for rich editors that own a larger token graph than the shared role table. A null Zed value explicitly records that upstream provides no verified Zed theme.

zed.description: Verified Zed theme name, or null when unavailable upstream.

opacity.description: Optional per-role opacity metadata (0.0-1.0) for surfaces that render translucent, e.g. the active window border.

source.description: Provenance for an imported palette. Omitted for the two hand-authored palettes (vague, oldworld). See theme/PALETTES.md for the construction rules that govern how roles are derived from these upstream values.

path.description: Path within the repository to the primary semantic-palette source file.

variant.description: Which named variant/table within that file this palette encodes.

revision.description: Pinned upstream commit SHA the values were taken from, when verified against a live fetch. Absent means the palette predates per-palette revision pinning; re-verify against upstream before trusting exact hex fidelity.
